Purchasely | https://www.purchasely.com | Senior iOS SDK Engineer | Paris, France | REMOTE (France) | Full-time (CDI) | Fluent French and English required | [€60k-€70k + BSPCE]

Purchasely is an in-app monetization platform: app teams design, launch and A/B test paywalls and onboarding screens without shipping an app update. Our SDKs (iOS, Android, Flutter, React Native, Cordova) are embedded in our customers' apps, so if our SDK crashes, someone else's app crashes. Stability, binary size, backward compatibility and clean public APIs come first.

You'll be a hands-on engineer on a small mobile team, owning the native iOS SDK: [StoreKit 1/2, UIKit/SwiftUI rendering, public API design, release process]. You'll also work directly with customers' engineering teams on tricky integrations, so you should enjoy reading other people's code and explaining yours.

We're looking for [5+] years of iOS with strong Swift, ideally with experience shipping a library or SDK used by third parties. Fluent French is a must: the engineering team works in French daily. Professional English is a must: our customers are located worldwide and support is in English, we also have coworkers from all over the world.

Process: no take-home. One 1h30 live technical session during the interview.

Direct applicants only, no agencies.

Details: https://purchasely.notion.site/Senior-iOS-SDK-Engineer-ee63d...

ALBERT | REMOTE ALMOST ANYWHERE IN THE WORLD| Hiring principal and distinguished engineers to build net new products | up to ~ $750k Hiring: exceptional consumer product engineers at Albert.

We're a consumer fintech with 20M+ users who trust us to budget, save, invest, and bank in one place. Profitable for 4+ years. And as of today, our average employee tenure is 3.6 years, a number you almost never see in startup tech, and one we're quietly proud of. People stay because the work is good, the people are sharp, and we've built something worth staying for.

Now we're building net-new consumer products from zero, and we're looking for people who love to tinker and build stuff to ship them with us.

The kind of person we're looking for: • Top fraction of a percentile in craft, the kind of good that's hard to fake • Builds for fun, not just for work. The kind who ships a working prototype over the weekend and can't help themselves • Comfortable owning 0 to 1 consumer products end-to-end • Allergic to politics, theater, and bureaucracy

What you get: • Remote, anywhere with reasonable timezone overlap (and for someone truly exceptional, we'll make async work) • Real scale from day one (20M+ users, real money, real consequences) • Compensation that beats the market. We pay well and we mean it. Base, discretionary year-end bonus, meaningful 401(k) match, and meaningful equity in a profitable, growing unicorn (the kind that's actually worth something) • Platinum PPO health benefits with Blue Shield, top of the top of the line, covering your entire family • A mission worth your time: make money simple, so people spend less time managing it and keep more of it • Small senior-heavy teams, direct ownership, no layers • Forthcoming with the business metrics that matter, so you always know how the company is actually doing • The startup perks done right: catered lunches, wellness stipend, team offsites, casual dress. The stuff that compounds when you're showing up engaged for years, not months • Profitable for 4+ years, so you build with conviction, not runway anxiety

Stack: python, claude, postgres, react.js /react native

If this is you, email us at recruiting@albert.com

Also, we carefully review every application. If we think there may be a fit, we'll reach out within a few business days. Either way, thank you for your interest in what we're building and for taking the time to connect with us.

Rinse provides dry cleaning and laundry delivery services to customers in twelve metropolitan areas in the US and Canada. We have sophisticated logistics optimization software, a polished consumer product, and firm business fundamentals. We're now over a decade old - this is a stable, yet consistently growing and innovating, company.

Our engineering team is distributed across the United States and internationally, and has been entirely remote for years now, but a desk can be provided in the above cities if you'd prefer.

We're open to both newly-graduated engineers or more senior engineers, provided they meet our bar. We're particularly interested in true full-stack engineers, with strong React / Typescript / CSS skills to complement comfort in a Python / Django environment. We're also seeking engineers with experience leveraging AI to automate complex operational processes.

This season, we're particularly interested in new grads or junior engineers, to round out the team.

We're also looking for people with experience manipulating video data at scale, for computer vision applications. Similarly, we're interested in adding people with experience building and managing MCP services.

You will join a high-caliber team where collaboration, honesty, and open communication are at the core of everything we do.

Search term bingo: Logistics, Django, Python, Optimization, React, React Native, Postgres, Mobile Engineer, Automation, Delivery, OR-tools, Forecasting, Vision, Physical AI, MCP

Treat Health | Full-stack Engineer (Elixir, Phoenix LiveView, React) | Helsinki, Finland | ONSITE | Full-time | Compensation in the link below

Treat Health is building healthcare where the right care takes minutes, not days. You describe your concern in your own words, our smart intake asks the follow-up questions a doctor would ask, and a licensed doctor reviews the whole picture and decides on the care. Prescriptions and records go straight to Kanta, Finland's national health archive.

Right now, agentic frontend engineering and agentic mobile app development matter most to us. We expect you to work across the whole stack, with our assistance and tooling.

Stack: Elixir, Phoenix LiveView, React, TypeScript, Tailwind, GCP, Cloudflare and Rust, with Swift and Kotlin for our native mobile apps. Claude is part of everyday work, from planning and coding to review. We care about how well you direct coding agents, not how fast you type.

Small team, high trust: you own problems end to end, with real influence on what we build. Health data stays in the EU, every sign-in uses strong identification, and patient data never ends up in logs.

For now, working on site in Helsinki is a must, and we can't offer relocation or visa support, so you need to already be able to work in Finland. We may hire remotely in the future, so check back later.

Compensation, details and how to apply: https://treat.health/en/careers/full-stack-engineer/

comment_text.value:
Flowstate (London, UK) — Founding Engineer — TypeScript / React / Postgres / AI

Flowstate (https://www.flowstate.inc) is building infrastructure for the emerging human + AI workforce.

Companies are rapidly adopting Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Copilot and internal agents, but most still have very little idea what that AI is actually doing, what it costs, what work it contributes to or whether it is making the organisation better.

We’re building the systems underneath that: an AI router and proxy, native macOS and Windows apps, attribution infrastructure that connects AI activity back to work and tools for understanding how humans and AI should operate together inside a company.

We’re a small early-stage team and this is a genuinely broad founding engineering role. You’ll work across product, infrastructure, integrations, desktop apps, AI systems and whatever else needs building. We’re looking for someone who has worked in an early-stage startup before and actually enjoys the pace, ambiguity and ownership that comes with it.

Details: - Location: London, UK - Working style: Hybrid, with regular time together in the office - Salary: £100k–£120k - Equity: 0.5%–1.5% - Benefits: Gym membership, breakfast and flexible hours - Role: Full-time

Apply: https://www.flowstate.inc/careers/

Ambito is a CRM-connected QBR generator for B2B sales teams. The product is live, with the sales module, template engine, and CRM integrations already built.

We're looking for a founding AI engineer to make the product significantly smarter and broader. This is an equity-only role initially (10+ hrs/week), working directly with the founders and our existing technical partner.

You'll work on:

AI product features: Build a native assistant that can answer questions about customer data, surface trends, provide setup guidance, and help generate QBRs. Retrieval, tool use, structured-data queries, evals, and cost control.

Customer Success: Extend the existing framework into account reviews, renewals, and customer health.

Integrations: Harden and expand CRM/CS integrations (Salesforce, HubSpot, etc.).

Product: Make the overall experience faster, simpler, and more AI-native where it actually helps.

We're looking for someone who has shipped LLM features in production, not just demos, and is comfortable with retrieval, embeddings, tool calling, agent workflows, and evaluation. You should also be able to work across React, TypeScript, and Node (Firebase experience is a plus).

You should think like a product engineer: turn varied customer requests into simple, flexible systems and work independently. Sales tech / RevOps / CS experience is a plus. Boston/MA is a plus.

To apply: Send a short note with something you've built using AI and why this problem interests you. No cover letter. LinkedIn or contact@ambito.io.

Datamint | Rust Systems Engineer, Browser Security | Remote (Global) | Full-time | $120k–$170k + Equity | https://datamint.xyz

We build high-throughput crawling and structured data extraction infra designed for AI agents and LLM pipelines.

If you’ve built scrapers recently, you already know the state of the market:

- Traditional proxy providers (Bright Data, Oxylabs, Smartproxy, Proxybase) give you raw IPs or massive unparsed HTML blobs, leaving you to deal with DOM bloat, token waste, and brittle parsing pipelines.

- Modern tools like Firecrawl or Jina made clean Markdown extraction easy for hobby setups, but they often struggle when you throw heavy SPAs, high-concurrency jobs, or hardened anti-bot walls (Cloudflare Under-Attack / Turnstile, Kasada, DataDome) at them.

- Rolling your own Playwright / Puppeteer cluster works until target sites deploy new JA4/TLS fingerprints, and your data team ends up spending 30% of their sprints fixing broken crawlers instead of shipping product.

We're tackling this by combining a low-latency Rust fast-fetch engine (JA4/TLS and HTTP/2 frame emulation) with an isolated stealth browser fleet, zero-code schema validation (JSON Schema/Pydantic), and native Model Context Protocol (MCP) support.

Trade-offs / where we fit: If you just need to curl a few static Wikipedia pages, a 10-line Python script is better and cheaper. But if you need reliable, structured data out of bot-defended sites without babying headless browsers, that's what we do.

We're looking for:

1. Rust Systems Engineer: High-concurrency network I/O, Axum/Tokio, TLS/BoringSSL fingerprinting, proxy routing matrices, and low-latency data pipelines.

2. Browser Security Engineer: Deep familiarity with browser internals (Firefox/Chromium source), canvas/WebGL/audio fingerprint evasion, CDP/WebDriver stealth, and familarity with anti-bot defenses.

Our stack: Rust, Next.js 16/React 19, TypeScript, hardened Firefox/dwx_crawler, Linux/Xvfb, SQLite WAL/Postgres.

If interested, shoot an email to jobs@datamint.xyz (or founders@datamint.xyz) with your GitHub, a project you built or broke, and what you find interesting in this space. No formal cover letter needed.

CABLE | Software Engineer (early team) | Sydney, Australia (ON-SITE) | Full-time | https://jobs.cable.energy/roles/3e2cd174-71f5-80ae-a1d2-db8b...

We're Australia's battery-backed electricity company. We fund, install and operate batteries on-site at small businesses, then supply their power at a firm, flat rate 20–40% below incumbents, making the economics work by optimising those batteries against wholesale prices. We're live with real customers. Team of six, backed by Systemiq and Black Nova; engineering includes Casey, who previously led Google engineering in Paris and Google Maps in Sydney.

We're AI-native: engineers, energy specialists and go-to-market colleagues all ship with coding agents. Each engineer owns a product end to end, from the commercial problem through to production. Flat structure, lots of ownership.

Areas you could own:

* Customer experience: quoting, onboarding and the customer app

* Metering and billing: turning high-volume interval data into accurate bills

* Energy-market and battery data: the market, weather and telemetry pipelines behind our decisions

* The agent-driven development platform the whole team builds on

Stack: TypeScript, React, Postgres, serverless. Intro chat, system design, an agentic build, then a day with the team.

Apply at https://jobs.cable.energy/roles/3e2cd174-71f5-80ae-a1d2-db8b... or email theo@cable.energy.

Hedge (YC) | Founding Engineer | San Francisco | ONSITE | Full-time | $150K-$250K + 1-3% equity

Hedge is an AI-native insurance company. We started as a wholesale brokerage for specialty commercial insurance, where AI agents do most of the work of placing policies: reading messy submissions, chasing missing information, working with 100+ insurance markets, and moving accounts toward coverage. The agents are in production doing real work for paying customers.

We're hiring our founding engineer to own the platform end to end: agents, evals, data pipelines, integrations, and reliability. Python/FastAPI, TypeScript/React, Postgres. You should be deeply technical, resourceful, and have taken something from zero to one. No insurance experience needed.

In office in SF

Apply: https://www.hedgespecialty.com/careers?ashby_jid=b79fa956-bd...

comment_text.value:
Shepherd (Series B) | ONSITE | San Francisco, CA & New York City, NY

At Shepherd, we're pursuing the most ambitious technical vision in commercial insurance: fully autonomous underwriting. Shepherd is an AI-native commercial insurance platform transforming how high-hazard industries get covered.

The infrastructure behind the AI boom (data centers, semiconductor fabs, renewable energy assets) has to be built and insured, but traditional carriers weren't built for this speed. We built Shepherd to solve that.

We announced our $42M Series B earlier this year! That brings our total funding to over $60M — led by Intact Private Capital, the investment arm of one of the largest insurers in the world. Intact is not only our lead investor but also a carrier partner, a testament to the confidence the incumbent industry has in what we're building.

We’re looking for product-minded, high ownership engineers to join our team! The Engineering team is HQ’d in SF, but we’re growing in NYC now too!

We’re hiring for 2 Senior Full Stack Software Engineers, 1 Machine Learning Engineer and 1 AI Product Manager in SF, and 2 Staff Full Stack Software Engineers in NYC. Engineers own projects end-to-end so full stack ability is expected.

Check out our open roles here: https://shepherdinsurance.com/careers Our stack includes: Typescript, React, Next.js, GraphQL w/ Apollo, Node.js, Postgres & Redis – If you have experience building AI agents or multi-step reasoning systems, we’d love to hear from you.

* In the form, be sure to mention that you heard about this opportunity via Hacker News. If you want to read more about our team and culture, check out our blog: https://shepherdinsurance.com/blog
